parameter_refs.name: roundabout_lane_role
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-mapped left or outer circular lane

quote: The following regulations pertain to the operation of vehicles within a roundabout: The operator of a vehicle who intends to exit a roundabout: Shall use the left lane to turn left or complete a U-turn.

activation.condition: Operator intends a U-turn exit from a roundabout.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Review source-mapped allocated lanes and original actor lane occupation during the U-turn.

obligation.description: Use the left lane to complete the U-turn.

timing.description: Observe allocated lane throughout circular traversal and actual opposite-direction departure.
